name: Shijigen Shoujo Ridia
source:
The mystery of the Bermuda Triangle has never been solved in a satisfactory way. A science object team is sent to investigate the strange occurrences. A time slip opens the way to another dimension, and the protagonist is dispatched to explore it, whatever dangers may await him there. 

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc88/yojigen-shjo-lydia]mobygames[/url]]
translation:
百慕大三角的谜团从未得到令人信服的解释。一支科学考察队受派前去调查当地的怪异现象。一次时空跳跃打开了通往异次元的通道，主人公奉命进入其中探索，无论前方等待着他的是何种危险。

[引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc88/yojigen-shjo-lydia]mobygames[/url]]
